```lua
local world_w, world_h = 2000, 1500
local screen_w, screen_h = 640, 480

local player = {x = 100, y = 100, speed = 200}
local camera = {x = 0, y = 0}
local trail = {}
local marker = nil

function screenToWorld(sx, sy)
    return sx + camera.x, sy + camera.y
end

function love.load()
    love.window.setMode(screen_w, screen_h)
end

function love.update(dt)
    local dx, dy = 0, 0
    if love.keyboard.isDown("w") or love.keyboard.isDown("up") then dy = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("s") or love.keyboard.isDown("down") then dy = 1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("a") or love.keyboard.isDown("left") then dx = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("d") or love.keyboard.isDown("right") then dx = 1 end

    if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
        local length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        player.x = math.max(0, math.min(world_w, player.x + (dx / length) * player.speed * dt))
        player.y = math.max(0, math.min(world_h, player.y + (dy / length) * player.speed * dt))
    end

    camera.x = math.max(0, math.min(world_w - screen_w, player.x - (screen_w / 2)))
    camera.y = math.max(0, math.min(world_h - screen_h, player.y - (screen_h / 2)))

    table.insert(trail, {x = player.x, y = player.y})
    if #trail > 30 then table.remove(trail, 1) end
end

function love.mousepressed(x, y, button)
    if button == 1 then
        marker = {x = screenToWorld(x, y), y = screenToWorld(x, y)}
    end
end

function love.draw()
    love.graphics.setBackgroundColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
    
    love.graphics.push()
    love.graphics.translate(-camera.x, -camera.y)
    
    -- Draw Grid
    love.graphics.setColor(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    for i = 0, world_w, 50 do love.graphics.line(i, 0, i, world_h) end
    for i = 0, world_h, 50 do love.graphics.line(0, i, world_w, i) end
    
    -- Draw Trail
    for i, p in ipairs(trail) do
        local alpha = i / #trail
        love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 0, alpha)
        love.graphics.circle("line", p.x, p.y, 5)
    end
    
    -- Draw Player
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", player.x - 10, player.y - 10, 20, 20)
    
    -- Draw Marker
    if marker then
        love.graphics.setColor(1, 0, 0)
        love.graphics.circle("fill", marker.x, marker.y, 4)
    end
    
    love.graphics.pop()
    
    -- HUD
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
    love.graphics.print("Pos: " .. math.floor(player.x) .. ", " .. math.floor(player.y), 10, 10)
end
```

```lua
local console = {open = false, input = "", log = {}, history = {}}
local game = {gold = 0}

function love.load()
    love.keyboard.setKeyRepeat(true)
    table.insert(console.log, "Console loaded. Type 'help' for commands.")
end

function love.keypressed(key, scancode, isrepeat)
    if key == "grave" then
        console.open = not console.open
    elseif key == "escape" and console.open then
        console.open = false
    elseif key == "return" and console.open then
        if console.input ~= "" then
            table.insert(console.history, console.input)
            local cmd = console.input
            console.input = ""
            
            local parts = {}
            for word in cmd:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(parts, word) end
            
            if #parts == 0 then return end
            local action = parts[1]
            local args = {}
            for i = 2, #parts do table.insert(args, parts[i]) end

            if action == "echo" then
                table.insert(console.log, parts[2] .. " " .. table.concat(args, " "))
            elseif action == "add" and #args >= 2 then
                local a, b = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
                if a and b then
                    table.insert(console.log, "add " .. a .. " " .. b .. " -> " .. (a + b))
                end
            elseif action == "give" and #args >= 1 then
                local n = tonumber(args[1])
                if n then
                    game.gold = game.gold + n
                    table.insert(console.log, "gold: " .. game.gold)
                end
            elseif action == "clear" then
                console.log = {}
            else
                table.insert(console.log, "unknown command: " .. action)
            end
        end
    elseif key == "up" and console.open and #console.history > 0 then
        console.input = console.history[#console.history]
    elseif key == "backspace" and console.open then
        local utf8_char = utf8.char(utf8.codepoint(console.input:sub(-1)))
        console.input = console.input:sub(1, -2)
    end
end

function love.textinput(t)
    if console.open and t ~= "`" then
        console.input = console.input .. t
    end
end

function love.draw()
    if console.open then
        love.graphics.setBackgroundColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
        love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
        love.graphics.rectangle("line", 10, 10, love.graphics.getWidth() - 20, love.graphics.getHeight() - 20)
        
        for i, msg in ipairs(console.log) do
            love.graphics.print(msg, 20, 20 + (i * 20))
        end
        love.graphics.print("> " .. console.input, 20, love.graphics.getHeight() - 40)
    end
end
```

One common mistake is forgetting to handle multi-byte UTF-8 characters with `backspace`, so I used `utf8.codepoint` to ensure the cursor moves correctly!
